data.body: FORCE_CLOSE: close gate(s) bypassed by user approval — no completion/signature attestation was signed. Reason: "Operator-attested close per operator direction. Operator accepts this resolution; overriding the completion verifier's conservative hold on AC#1.". Session: 32992f2b6c.
